description:
Solves a right-angle triangle.

    Use for: 'right angle triangle calculator', 'pythagoras calculator',
    'find the hypotenuse', 'missing side of a triangle', 'triangle angle
    calculator'.

    Give exactly two of a, b, c and angle_a_degrees (at least one a side). Sides
    3 and 4 give a hypotenuse of 5. c is the hypotenuse and must be the longest.

    Args:
        a: Side a.
        b: Side b.
        c: The hypotenuse.
        angle_a_degrees: Angle A, opposite side a.

    Returns:
        All three sides, both acute angles, the area and perimeter.
name: right_angle_triangle_calculator
